entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon, a planeswalker whose magic reaches beyond the dragons and who helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker (character) from whom Ugin learned little while trapping the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker (character) from whom Ugin gleaned the rudiments of lithomancy.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings trapped on Zendikar by Ugin.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the Eldrazi were trapped.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane whose history was rewritten by the changing of a single moment in its past.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: The Hunt Caller, who scorns the ainok.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A clan that saw Ugin's power as one more resource to exploit.

events.summary: The changing of a single moment in Tarkir's past rewrites its history.
events.quote: The changing of a single moment in Tarkir's past altered its future, rewriting its history.

events.summary: Ugin traps the Eldrazi on Zendikar, learning little from Sorin but the rudiments of lithomancy from Nahiri.
events.quote: While trapping the Eldrazi on Zendikar, Ugin learned little from Sorin
